mavzu: UNIT 1 LESSON 3 - He wants to be a/an

savollar.savol: "He wants to be a doctor" jumlasida "wants" fe'li qanday gap egasi bilan ishlatiladi?
"A" artikli qanday tovush bilan boshlanuvchi so'zlar oldidan ishlatiladi?
"An" artikli qanday tovush bilan boshlanuvchi so'zlar oldidan ishlatiladi?
"Doctor" so'zining o'zbekcha tarjimasi qaysi?
"Engineer" so'zining o'zbekcha tarjimasi qaysi?
"Want to be" iborasi o'zbek tilida qanday ma'noni bildiradi?
"Teacher" so'zi qaysi harf bilan boshlanadi?
"Artist" so'zi oldidan qaysi artikl ishlatiladi?
"Nurse" so'zining o'zbekcha tarjimasi qaysi?
"She wants to be a nurse" gapida kim haqida gapirilyapti?
To'g'ri artikl tanlang: He wants to be ___ doctor.
To'g'ri artikl tanlang: She wants to be ___ engineer.
To'g'ri artikl tanlang: I want to be ___ actor.
To'g'ri artikl tanlang: He wants to be ___ pilot.
Gapni to'g'ri to'ldiring: I want ___ be a teacher.
Quyidagi gaplardan qaysi biri grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri?
variantlar: He wanting to be a doctor
He wants to be a doctor
He want to be a doctor

savollar.savol: "Tom, want, be, a farmer" so'zlaridan to'g'ri gap tuzing.
variantlar: Tom to want be a farmer
Tom want to be a farmer
Tom wants to be a farmer

savollar.savol: "Farmer" so'zi oldidan qaysi artikl ishlatiladi?
Quyidagilardan qaysi biri noto'g'ri gap?
variantlar: I wants to be a doctor
He wants to be an artist
She wants to be a nurse

savollar.savol: "I want to be a pilot" gapida "want" so'zi nima uchun "s" qo'shimchasisiz kelgan?
"Actor" va "engineer" so'zlari uchun qaysi artikl to'g'ri ishlatiladi va nima uchun?
Quyidagi gapda ikkita xato bor: "She want to be an doctor". Xatolarni to'g'irlang.
variantlar: She want to be a doctor
She wants to be a doctor
She wanting to be a doctor
She wants to be an doctor

savollar.savol: "He wants to be ___ artist because he likes drawing" gapini to'ldirish uchun qaysi artikl va nima sababdan tanlanadi?
variantlar: an, chunki "artist" unli tovush bilan boshlanadi

savollar.savol: Agar bir kishi kasbini tanlashda sababini aytmoqchi bo'lsa (masalan, odamlarga yordam berish uchun), qaysi kasb va gap tuzilishi to'g'ri bo'ladi?
variantlar: He wants to being a doctor helping people
He want to be doctor for help people
He wants to be a doctor to help people
He wants doctor to be help people

savollar.savol: "I want to be an engineer" va "He wants to be an engineer" gaplari orasidagi grammatik farq nimada?
Quyidagi kasblardan qaysi birida "an" artikli ishlatiladi va nima uchun: teacher, doctor, actor, farmer?
"She wants to be a nurse because she wants to help sick people" gapida qaysi qism sababni bildiradi?
variantlar: She wants to be a nurse
because she wants to help sick people

savollar.savol: Agar gapda ega "They" bo'lsa, "want" fe'liga qanday qo'shimcha qo'shilishi kerak va nima uchun?
variantlar: Hech qanday qo'shimcha qo'shilmaydi, chunki ko'plik ega

savollar.savol: "He wants to be a/an ___" gapida bo'sh joyga "artist" so'zi qo'yilsa, qaysi artikl to'g'ri bo'ladi va sabab nima?
variantlar: an, chunki "artist" unli tovush "a" bilan boshlanadi

savollar.savol: Quyidagi ikki gapni solishtiring: "I want to be a pilot" va "He wants to be an engineer". Ikkala gapda nima farq va nima o'xshashlik bor?
variantlar: Farq - artikl va fe'l shakli; o'xshashlik - ikkalasi ham kasb haqida
Farq - faqat kasb nomi, artikl bir xil
